bio.text: Shawn Keenan is the Democratic candidate for Idaho Secretary of State in 2026; he lost to Republican Phil McGrane in the 2022 election.
He is a mortgage broker and loan officer who lives in Coeur d'Alene, and his parents moved with him to Idaho when he was 1 year old.
He runs a nonprofit called the North Idaho Kindness Project and has worked on several Democratic campaigns in North Idaho.

sources.title: The race for Idaho's top election official, the secretary of state, is a rematch
